newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore share market opens slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Singapore share market opens slightly firmer.

text.p: Singapore shares opened slightly firmer but the market is not expected to chalk up any big gains later in the day, dealers said on Monday.
"There was some recovery on the back of some buying of blue chips which fell heavily on Friday," one dealer with a Singapore-based brokerage firm said.
"Any recovery is will be capped as the upside is limited. We need to get the bad news out of the way for the market to improve," he said.
At 0130 GMT, the STII was up about five points or 0.25 per cent at 2,081.88 from Friday's 2,076.65.
Market activity was thin with just 8.82 million shares traded. Gainers were ahead of losers by 39 to 30.
Cycle & Carriage led the gainers, putting on Singapore $0.30 (US$0.21).
Dealers reported heavy selling of Singapore Press foreign shares which was down S$0.20.
